effectcraft.reuse: Original Range equations/random permutation reused by shared legacy/lazy sampler; original Wiggly/hash3/selector-noise ported synchronously to TS BigInt/u64. No source renderer/model/UI/time system imported.
effectcraft.reasonForSyncAdapter: Selectors execute per source unit/dimension in the existing Native Stage JS. A separate asynchronous Rust call for each coefficient would add an unnecessary bridge; unchanged native Rust provides an independent numerical oracle.

unicode.policy: Group by pinned UCD block and general-category bucket; split decimal runs into ten-digit sets. Marks, separators, format controls and unassigned/private-use scalars do not substitute. Immutable lookup, no runtime ICU classification dependence. Explicit group policy, not an equivalence claim to an unpublished Adobe lookup.

existing: Signal/evaluate/sourceTimeContext, glyph/source mapping, HarfRust/Skrifa, Clipper2, Three pure transforms and Native renderer/owner are reused.
